status: Locked after implementation and target-free artifact validation, before any future metric from the covariance-aware sparse-identity arm was read.
claim_boundary: One-case post-open development smoke on a previously examined PhysTwin interaction. It can reject this exact arm or authorize object-disjoint source development, but cannot establish transfer, calibration, state of the art, or permission to inspect any fresh target.
question: Does a covariance-aware CoTracker3 material-identity channel improve the frozen released-dense discrepancy predictor when perception reliability is residual-independent and correlated views retain conservative metric uncertainty?
case_selection: The already-open single_lift_cloth case was fixed as a schema and numerical smoke before this arm produced any future score. No fresh or held-v8 object is involved.

method.description: Retain released final_data pseudo-tracks as the dense geometry channel and use CoTracker3 only as a sparse material-identity endpoint override with full metric covariance.
method.association: Exact archived original PhysTwin material identity; no state residual determines association or prior reliability.
method.correlation_treatment: Duplicate camera poses are collapsed, cross-view information is normalized rather than summed as independent precision, and common-mode plus two-view uncertainty remains in covariance.
method.innovation_treatment: The PhysTwin innovation enters exactly once through the robust inlier/outlier likelihood after prior reliability and metric covariance are fixed.

allowed_fields: candidate and physical-baseline future Chamfer distance
candidate and physical-baseline future manual-track error
automatic identity count and prefix valid fraction
two-view fraction, prior reliability, and metric observation standard deviation
the primary arm's prefix-selected cap, scale, and temporal gamma
future_read.forbidden_fields: Every non-primary candidate and per-case metric oracle emitted by the broad development runner remain out of scope and must not influence this method or gate.

smoke_gate.pass_action: Freeze this exact observation path and design an object-disjoint source transfer/calibration gate. Do not inspect any fresh target.
smoke_gate.fail_action: Stop this exact sparse-identity arm without tuning covariance, support, reliability, cap, or temporal settings against this future.

information_boundary.manual_tracks_role: Evaluation only after the candidate prediction and prefix-only selector are fixed.

forbidden: printing or inspecting the broad runner's best candidate, metric oracle, or non-primary candidate futures
changing sparse covariance, reliability, camera support, selector, cap, or temporal settings after this future is read
using future RGB, object clouds, or manual tracks to build or select a prediction
calling this one opened case independent, confirmatory, calibrated, or state of the art
opening any fresh-object outcome before an object-disjoint source gate passes
opening, inspecting, modifying, or rerunning any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
